say:2:1022046001:1.source_cn: 怎么了？铁蹄先生？你的钱箱丢了吗？

say:3:1022046002:1.text: I bent down to grab a crowbar from my toolbox, and I could feel someone creeping up behind me...
say:3:1022046002:1.source_cn: 没错，没错！刚刚我弯腰在工具箱里翻羊角锤，感觉好像有人...
say:3:1022046002:1.male: I bent down to grab a crowbar from my toolbox, and I could feel someone creeping up behind me...
say:3:1022046002:1.female: I bent down to grab a crowbar from my toolbox, and I could feel someone creeping up behind me...

say:4:1022046003:1.text: By the time I turned around, I bumped into the wall, and it was too late. My money box, three days' worth of earnings, was gone!
say:4:1022046003:1.source_cn: 我一转身，角撞上了墙面，就晚了这么一秒——钱箱，我的钱...
say:4:1022046003:1.male: By the time I turned around, I bumped into the wall, and it was too late. My money box, three days' worth of earnings, was gone!
say:4:1022046003:1.female: By the time I turned around, I bumped into the wall, and it was too late. My money box, three days' worth of earnings, was gone!

say:5:1022046004:1.text: Huh, sounds like the thief was quick.
say:5:1022046004:1.source_cn: 嗯，听起来应该是个身手矫健的小毛贼。
say:5:1022046004:1.male: Huh, sounds like the thief was quick.
say:5:1022046004:1.female: Huh, sounds like the thief was quick.

say:6:1022046005:1.text: But, hmm, a box that heavy? Even a quick thief couldn't have gotten far lugging that around.
say:6:1022046005:1.source_cn: 不过，既然是三天的营业额，想必钱箱不轻。搬着那么重的箱...
say:6:1022046005:1.male: But, hmm, a box that heavy? Even a quick thief couldn't have gotten far lugging that around.
say:6:1022046005:1.female: But, hmm, a box that heavy? Even a quick thief couldn't have gotten far lugging that around.

say:7:1022046006:1.text: Don't worry! I'll search the area and get your money box back—every last coin.
say:7:1022046006:1.source_cn: 我会在附近搜索。请放心，我们一定会把你的钱箱找回来，分...
say:7:1022046006:1.male: Don't worry! I'll search the area and get your money box back—every last coin.
say:7:1022046006:1.female: Don't worry! I'll search the area and get your money box back—every last coin.
